relations.text: SiTimeは、アナログ回路の製造を主にTSMCとUMCに依存している
relations.text_en: SiTime relies primarily on TSMC and UMC for its analog circuits fabrication

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: ("Teledyne") for our MEMS fabrication, and primarily on TSMC and UMC for our analog circuits fabrication, and any disruption in the supply of wafers or any increases in the wafer or materials prices could adversely affect our gross margins and our ability to meet customer demands in a timely manner, or at all, and lead to reduced revenue.

relations.text: 過去に、TSMCなど一部ファウンドリのアナログ回路の供給制約で、一部製品の需要増に十分応えられなかったことがある
relations.text_en: In the past, supply constraints at certain foundries including TSMC limited SiTime's ability to fully satisfy an increase in demand for some products

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: In the past, we have been impacted by a number of industry-wide supply constraints affecting the supply of analog circuits manufactured by certain foundries, including TSMC, and affecting outsourced semiconductor assembly and test providers (“OSATs”), which limited our ability to fully satisfy an increase in demand for some of our products.

relations.text: SiTimeは、MEMSタイミング製品とアナログ回路の製造を主にBosch、TSMC、UMC、Teledyneに頼る
relations.text_en: SiTime relies on Bosch, TSMC, UMC and Teledyne as its primary foundries and suppliers for MEMS timing devices and analog circuits.

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: We currently rely on Bosch, TSMC, UMC, and Teledyne as our primary foundries and suppliers for our MEMS timing devices and analog circuits, and only a few foundry vendors have the capability to manufacture our most advanced solutions, in particular with respect to our MEMS technology.

relations.text_en: SiTime primarily relies on ASE, Carsem, and UTAC for assembly and testing

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: We currently primarily rely on ASE, Carsem, and UTAC for assembly and testing, as well as Daishinku, UTAC, Hana Semiconductor (Ayutthaya) Co., Ltd, and ASE for ceramic packaging for some of our products.

relations.text: Appleは最大のエンドカスタマーで、売上高に占める割合は2025年17%、2024年22%、2023年21%だった
relations.text_en: Sales attributable to Apple, SiTime's largest end customer, were approximately 17%, 22%, and 21% of revenue for 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: Sales attributable to Apple, our largest end customer accounted for approximately 17%, 22%, and 21% of our revenue for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively.

relations.text: SiTimeは、販売代理店経由で製品を販売するAppleとの間で、取引の枠組みを定めた開発・供給契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: SiTime has a development and supply agreement with Apple that provides a general framework for certain transactions, although sales go through distributors

source.label: SiTime 10-K
source.quote: Although we sell our products to this end customer through distributors on a purchase order basis, including, but not limited to, Pernas, and Quantek, we have a development and supply agreement, which provides a general framework for certain transactions with Apple.
source.note: 販売代理店経由の販売です。
